continuity.campaign_development: May 60 BCE: Valerius reviewed his senior commanders and publicly rewarded demonstrated military skill, including officers without prominent noble families. The awards broadened internal recognition of competence and produced new local reporting about one decorated commander's reputation. Intelligence rose to 963 and relations to 98; other core metrics remained unchanged.
